arxiv-1905-02727.title: Constraining the Self-Interacting Neutrino Interpretation of the Hubble Tension
arxiv-1905-02727.creator: Nikita Blinov, Kevin J. Kelly, Gordan Krnjaic, Samuel D. McDermott
arxiv-1905-02727.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Nikita Blinov, Kevin J. Kelly, Gordan Krnjaic, Samuel D. McDermott. Large, non-standard neutrino self-interactions have been shown to resolve the ∼ 4 ​ σ \sim 4\sigma tension in Hubble constant measurements and a milder tension in the amplitude of matter fluctuations. We demonstrate that interactions of the necessary size imply the existence of a force-carrier with a large neutrino coupling ( > 10 − 4 >10^{-4} ) and mass in the keV – 100 MeV range.

arxiv-2107-14503.title: Three Core-Collapse Supernovae with Nebular Hydrogen Emission.
arxiv-2107-14503.creator: J. Sollerman, S. Yang, S. Schulze, N. L. Strotjohann, A. Jerkstrand, S. D. Van Dyk, E. C. Kool, C. Barbarino, T. G. Brink, R. Bruch, K. De, A. V. Filippenko, C. Fremling, K. C. Patra, D. Perley, L. Yan, Y. Yang, I. Andreoni, R. Campbell, M. Coughlin, M. Kasliwal, Y.-L. Kim, M. Rigault, K. Shin, A. T
arxiv-2107-14503.description: Abstract We present the discovery and extensive follow-up observations of SN 2020jfo, a Type IIP supernova (SN) in the nearby (14.5 Mpc) galaxy M61. Optical light curves (LCs) and spectra from the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF), complemented with data from Swift /UVOT and near-infrared photometry is presented.

arxiv-2108-08905.title: Statistical Learning to Operationalize a Domain Agnostic Data Quality Scoring
arxiv-2108-08905.creator: Sezal Chug
arxiv-2108-08905.description: Abstract Abstract Background Data is expanding at an unimaginable rate, and with this development comes the responsibility of the quality of data. Data Quality refers to the relevance of the information present and helps in various operations like decision making and planning in a particular organization.

arxiv-2111-09214.title: The use of hypermodels to understand binary neutron star collisions
arxiv-2111-09214.creator: Gregory Ashton 1,2 and Tim Dietrich 3,4
arxiv-2111-09214.description: Abstract Gravitational waves from the collision of binary neutron stars provide a unique opportunity to study the behaviour of supranuclear matter, the fundamental properties of gravity, and the cosmic history of our Universe. However, given the complexity of Einstein’s Field Equations, theoretical models that enable source-property inference suffer from systematic uncertainties due to simplifying assumptions.

arxiv-2112-11821.title: To the synthesis and characterization of layered metal phosphorus triselenides proposed for electrochemical sensing and energy applications (Manuscript was initially submitted to ACS Catalysis as a Comment for Ref. 22; however was rejected after appeal)
arxiv-2112-11821.creator: Yuriy Dedkov, Mouhui Yan, Elena Voloshina
arxiv-2112-11821.description: Abstract Recent studies reported on the synthesis and characterization of several bulk crystals of layered metal triselenophosphites MPSe 3 (M = transition metals). In these works characterization was performed via a combination of different bulk- and surface-sensitive experimental methods accompanied by DFT calculations.

arxiv-2201-10519.title: Pair-instability mass loss for top-down compact object mass calculations
arxiv-2201-10519.creator: M. Renzo, D. D. Hendriks, L. A. C. van Son, R. Farmer
arxiv-2201-10519.description: Abstract Population synthesis relies on semi-analytic formulae to determine masses of compact objects from the (helium or carbon-oxygen) cores of collapsing stars. Such formulae are combined across mass ranges that span different explosion mechanisms, potentialy introducing artificial features in the compact object mass distribution. Such artifacts impair the interpretation of gravitational-wave observations.

arxiv-2312-05509.title: Rank-two reflexive sheaves on the projective space with second Chern class equal to four
arxiv-2312-05509.creator: Marcos Jardim, Alan Muniz
arxiv-2312-05509.description: Abstract . We study rank-two reflexive sheaves on ℙ 3 {\mathbb{P}^{3}} with c 2 = 4 c_{2}=4 , expanding on previous results for c 2 ≤ 3 c_{2}\leq 3 . We show that every spectrum not previously ruled out is realized.

arxiv-2409-09753.title: DARDA : Domain-Aware Real-Time Dynamic Neural Network Adaptation
arxiv-2409-09753.creator: Shahriar Rifat, Jonathan Ashdown, Francesco Restuccia
arxiv-2409-09753.description: Abstract Test Time Adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a practical solution to mitigate the performance degradation of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) in the presence of corruption/ noise affecting inputs. Existing approaches in TTA continuously adapt the DNN , leading to excessive resource consumption and performance degradation due to accumulation of error stemming from lack of supervision.

arxiv-2412-02374.title: Wandering and escaping: recoiling massive black holes in cosmological simulations
arxiv-2412-02374.creator: Chi An Dong-Páez, Marta Volonteri, Yohan Dubois, Ricarda S. Beckmann, Maxime Trebitsch
arxiv-2412-02374.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chi An Dong-Páez, Marta Volonteri, Yohan Dubois, Ricarda S. Beckmann, Maxime Trebitsch. After a merger of two massive black holes (MBHs), the remnant receives a gravitational wave (GW) recoil kick that can have a strong effect on its future evolution. The magnitude of the kick ( v recoil v_{\mathrm{recoil}} ) depends on the mass ratio and the alignment of the spins and orbital angular momenta, therefore on the previous evolution of the MBHs.

arxiv-2504-11103.title: FCC feasibility studies: Impact of tracker- and calorimeter-detector performance on jet flavor identification and Higgs physics analyses
arxiv-2504-11103.creator: Haider Abidi, Ketevi A. Assamagan, Diallo Boye, Elizabeth Brost, Viviana Cavaliere, Anna E. Connelly, George Iakovidis, Ang Li, Marc-André Pleier, Andrea Sciandra, Michele Selvaggi, Scott Snyder, Robert Szafron, Abraham Tishelman-Charny, Iza Veliscek
arxiv-2504-11103.description: Abstract The extensive and ambitious physics program planned at the Future Circular Collider for electrons and positrons (FCC-ee) imposes strict constraints on detector performance. This work investigates how different detector properties impact jet flavor identification and their subsequent effects on high-profile physics analyses.

arxiv-2509-19106.title: Trends in the electronic structure of borophene polymorphs
arxiv-2509-19106.creator: Alam Osorio, Lucia Reining, Francesco Sottile
arxiv-2509-19106.description: Abstract Borophene is a two-dimensional material made out of boron atoms only. It exhibits polymorphism and different allotropes can be studied in terms of a rigid electronic structure, where only the occupation of the states change with the respect to the number of electrons available in the system (self-doping).

arxiv-2509-20119.title: A Simple Data Augmentation Strategy for Text-in-Image Scientific VQA
arxiv-2509-20119.creator: Belal Shoer, Yova Kementchedjhieva
arxiv-2509-20119.description: Abstract Scientific visual question answering poses significant challenges for vision-language models due to the complexity of scientific figures and their multimodal context. Traditional approaches treat the figure and accompanying text (e.g., questions and answer options) as separate inputs. EXAMS-V introduced a new paradigm by embedding both visual and textual content into a single image.

pmc-12441682.title: Seasonal shifts in pan-Arctic Ocean downward radiation and key drivers
pmc-12441682.creator: Yujun Liu, Haiyan Li, Yijun He, Yingying Liu
pmc-12441682.description: SummaryThe Arctic, highly sensitive to climate change, is warming rapidly due to increasing greenhouse gas emissions, resulting in a significant rise in downward radiation over the pan-Arctic Ocean in recent decades. However, the key drivers and their relative contributions remain unclear.

pmc-12532944.title: Implementability of clinical practice guidelines: the review and development of a Comprehensive Framework for Guideline Implementability (CFGI)
pmc-12532944.creator: Dongmei Zhong, Yimin Wu, Gregory A Aarons, Alison M Hutchinson, William CW Wong, Sensen Lv, Zaiwei Song, Yanni Wu, David Makram Bishai, Ken Chen, Nan Yang, Yaolong Chen, Zhaolan Liu, Lijiao Yan, Pengxiang Zhou, Dong Roman Xu
pmc-12532944.description: IntroductionWe define clinical practice guideline (CPGs) implementability as the characteristics of the guideline that reflect the extent to which it is likely to be adopted in clinical practice. Our objectives were to create a comprehensive and evidence-informed framework of guideline implementability (CFGI).MethodsA mixed-methods approach was used.

pmc-12650112.title: Clostridioides difficile Infection in Special Populations: Focus on Inflammatory Bowel Disease—A Narrative Review from Pathogenesis to Management
pmc-12650112.creator: Cristina Seguiti, Enrico Tettoni, Edoardo Pezzuto, Viviana Gerardi, Alessandro Quadarella, Paola Cesaro, Paolo Colombini
pmc-12650112.description: Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) is a major complication in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), due to coexistence of altered microbiota, chronic inflammation, and immune dysregulation. This narrative review summarizes recent evidence on the epidemiology, pathogenesis, risk factors, diagnosis, and management of CDI in IBD.

pmc-12847697.title: High-salt diet induces immune-independent re-differentiation, metabolic shut down and cell cycle arrest of melanoma
pmc-12847697.creator: Clivia Lisowski, Natascha E Stumpf, Katarzyna Jobin, Daniela Klaus, Melanie Eichler, Ann-Kathrin Baumgart, Olena Babyak, Mirjam Meißner, Agnes Schröder, Patrick Neubert, Vanessa Schmitt, Marcel Michla, Süleyman Bozkurt, Jelena Zurkovic, Daniel Hinze, Jana Liebing, Matthias Eckhardt, Christoph Heuser
pmc-12847697.description: High salt diet (HSD) is known to reduce cancer growth in some tumor models, which has been attributed to tissue accumulation of sodium that enhances local anti-tumor immunity. Here, we show that a HSD inhibits melanoma growth independent of sodium accumulation and immune cells in skin and lung.

pmc-13176462.title: Efficacy of Prone Positioning in Non‐ARDS Patients With Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13176462.creator: Hany A. Zaki, Yavuz Yigit, Eman E. Shaban, Amira Shaban, Ahmed Shaban, Mohamed Gafar Abdelrahim, Mohamed Abosamak, Ali Elkandow, Karima Chaabna
pmc-13176462.description: BackgroundProne positioning (PP) is established for the management of hypoxemic respiratory failure (HRF) due to acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). However, its effectiveness in patients with HRF unrelated to ARDS remains unclear. This systematic review and meta‐analysis aimed to evaluate the clinical outcomes of PP in patients with non‐ARDS HRF.

pmc-13213273.title: Tailoring desensitization in intestinal transplants: C1q guided protocol for highly sensitized recipients
pmc-13213273.creator: Vighnesh Venkatasamy, Jennifer Garcia, Amay Banker, Mahmoud Morsi, Arinc Ozturk, Gennaro Selvaggi, Akin Tekin, Rafael Miyashiro, Hugo Kaneku, Phillip Ruiz, Rodrigo Vianna, Adela Mattiazzi
pmc-13213273.description: BackgroundSensitized candidates for isolated intestinal or modified multivisceral transplantation (MMVT) face prolonged wait times and higher rejection risk from donor-specific antibodies (DSA). While desensitization is established in kidney transplantation, data in intestine/MMVT are limited.Case reportThree adults with cPRA ≥ 95% underwent desensitization with Rituximab, plasma exchange, and monthly infusions of IgG, guided by C1q DSA testing.

Therefore, the purpose of this report was to determine physiologic responses of simulated shipboard firefighting tasks.Materials and MethodsNineteen subjects (age: 24 ± 5 y, V˙O2peak: 44.

pmc-13338008.title: The Pentatricopeptide Repeat Protein OsPPR7 Confers Cold Tolerance at the Booting Stage in Rice by Regulating ABA and ROS Homeostasis
pmc-13338008.creator: Changsheng Liu, Jingwen Li, Yantao Li, Yingying Wang, Dongyuan Si, Jingguo Wang, Hongliang Zheng, Wei Xin, Detang Zou, Hualong Liu, Lei Lei, Luomiao Yang
pmc-13338008.description: Cold stress at the booting stage severely disrupts pollen development and drastically reduces grain yield in rice. Uncovering the genetic basis of cold tolerance is essential for breeding resilient varieties. Here, we identified a cold‑sensitive mutant, csb1, from an EMS‑mutagenized population of the cold‑tolerant japonica variety MK1, which exhibits significantly impaired seed‑setting under cold stress.

pmc-13681645.creator: Ramakrishna Allam, B. Kothainayagi, P.A. Sudhir, Vanitha R. Muralikumar, S. Sajitha, K. Sudharsan, S. Vasanth
pmc-13681645.description: Jalaukavacharana (leech therapy), an integral part of Ayurvedic medicine, is widely recognized for its benefits in managing chronic wounds, inflammatory conditions, and vascular disorders.
